entries.name: GitHub
entries.job: PRs, reviews, CI. Notify in, reply out.
entries.does: Connects GitHub two-way. PR and issue comments, review requests, and CI@you land in the Chat inbox. Reply ops are create_issue_comment, create_pull_request_review_comment, and create_pull_request_review. Bot send needs cutover attached and human_gate approved. Merge is HITL.

entries.name: Slack
entries.job: Eng mentions in, replies out. Not a chat home.
entries.does: Connects Slack eng two-way. app_mention and DM @mentions land in the inbox. Reply op is post_message on the bound composer. Public channel blasts are HITL. Bot send needs cutover attached and human_gate approved.

entries.name: Studio MCP
entries.job: First-party Studio tools for in-studio seats.
entries.does: Installs the first-party Studio MCP server. Seats call Studio tools in-process (rooms, board gates, catalog). Does not replace vendor MCPs. Auth stays outside this package. No life-OS tools.
